_comment: Every camera reaches the engine as rtsp://, whatever the upstream is. mediamtx does the
normalising (deploy/compose/mediamtx.yml) so RtspSource is the only network path in the
engine — spec §5. Copy this to cameras.json and edit.
zone is optional and constrained to room | corridor | dayroom. Omit it and the camera is
ungrouped, which is fine. Give it a value the engine does not know and startup fails, on
purpose: a typo'd zone is a camera the operator meant to group and silently did not.

cameras.label: Avenue (looped footage)
cameras._note: Real pedestrians. This is the one that actually exercises detection, tracking and the escalation gate. Push it in with: ffmpeg -re -stream_loop -1 -i datasets/avenue/avenue_01.mp4 -c copy -f rtsp rtsp://localhost:8554/avenue_01

cameras.label: Public demo stream (live)
cameras._note: Unified Streaming's public demo, h264 720p25, pulled on demand by mediamtx. Verifies live HLS ingest and reconnect. No people in it, so expect no escalations — an empty event list here is the gate working, not failing.

cameras.label: Recorded footage (file replay)
cameras._note: Not a URL — anything without an rtsp(s) scheme is read as a file path and builds a FileSource. Needs no mediamtx and no network, so it is the quickest way to see the whole pipeline produce a real description. Deliberately has no zone: the field is optional, and this is what an ungrouped camera looks like. Give it one from the console (PATCH /cameras/replay_01) and this file is rewritten in place.
